mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the jaw links was most worthwhile: the explanation made clear how the slider closes the jaws without bending the links.

leastWorthwhile.text: The syringe cradle and mounting were straightforward preparations, but neither result explained much about how the drive would work.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that the separate links can follow different arcs while closing the jaws together.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary, though the syringe's eventual role was not demonstrated in this chapter.

continue.text: Yes. The linkage and return-band test were worth seeing, and I am curious how the jaws will be controlled from the other end.
